purpose: Deferred CPU C0 mechanism diagnosis, not an adoption screen
implementation_status: Specification only; no collector or diagnostic harness implemented or executed

recommendation.next_primary_work: GPU route and readiness observation under the existing final placement
recommendation.cpu_abs_adoption_status: On hold; the completed original C0 cross-library total-time gate failed
recommendation.fundamental_identifiability_limit: CPU library is fixed within each process. Additional counters can describe accompanying mechanisms but do not identify library effects separately from arbitrary process effects.

forbidden_actions: Repeat the original eight-process suite until a pass is found
Discard slow observations or subtract placebo/counter-derived corrections to pass the original gate
Rebuild CPU libraries as part of collecting these diagnostics
Change cgroup, NUMA, affinity, ASLR, production API, fan, power, or GPU settings
Interpret absent or unreadable counters as zero
Run the saved build/run scripts automatically

retained_original_work.wall_scope: 32 synchronous ggml_backend_graph_compute calls, including their internal backend work
unchanged_supporting_contracts: expected output and cache membership checks
bounded finite run with no automatic retries
retained_original_work.case_history: A future C0-only run answers a changed context question. If diagnosing the original mixed-case carryover, preserve and record its case sequence; do not silently equate C0-only with the original protocol.

required_metadata: actual OpenMP runtime path and SHA
tier0_read_only_context.environment_policy: Record presence and value after backend initialization; do not add or modify settings

cgroup_resolution.levels: leaf and visible ancestors of the relevant CPU hierarchy
cgroup_resolution.missing_or_unreadable: Preserve path, errno and availability=false; never infer unlimited or zero
cgroup_resolution.interpretation_limit: The cgroup or ancestor can include other processes. A change is not necessarily caused by the harness. An unlimited leaf does not establish absence of ancestor limits.

case_boundary_context: cgroup CPU stat snapshots before and after the case
cgroup PSI cumulative totals if available
host /proc/pressure/cpu under a distinct host scope

placement_receipts.maps: Existing startup map plus a post-all-timed-work receipt if added
placement_receipts.numa_maps: Optional one read after all timed loops and before Resources cleanup; never per chunk
placement_receipts.reason: numa_maps scans the virtual address space; it describes mapping and page placement, not remote accesses or cache misses
placement_receipts.limit: A post-run placement receipt does not establish placement during an earlier C0 case

when: case boundaries when adding context snapshots
clock_pair.uncertainty: Preserve the enclosing monotonic interval and any realtime discontinuity; do not claim exact sensor/chunk correspondence

tier1_process_snapshot.scope: All threads in the harness process
ordered_protocol: Keep original mode(actual); compute() outside wall
original 32 synchronous compute calls, no extra instrumentation
original validation, tensor_get, memcmp and sample storage
tier1_process_snapshot.allocation_policy: Allocate and touch all snapshot/sample storage before warmup
tier1_process_snapshot.clock_resolution_receipt: clock_getres for original wall and process CPU clocks once at startup
tier1_process_snapshot.api_failure_policy: Retain error and partial evidence; classify diagnostic incomplete, do not silently use zero or switch clocks
tier1_process_snapshot.interval_limit: CPU and rusage readings have different enclosing windows extending outside the original wall interval; do not assert simultaneous atomic snapshots or exact interval equality

measurement_perturbation_control.preferred_candidate_for_a_future_diagnos: Balanced half-chunk snapshots in one newly built common harness
measurement_perturbation_control.assignment_validation: Offline integer checks in SAVED_CONTEXT_AUDIT.json; collector unimplemented
comparisons: F versus E/O and E/S with equal work and flag balance
measurement_perturbation_control.carryover_limit: Before/after snapshots may change cache, TLB, spin/sleep, and next-arm state. On/off comparison does not completely eliminate temporal or carryover confounding.
measurement_perturbation_control.full_sampling_alternative: Must be chosen prospectively if all-chunk counters are required, with a separate burden control; never select after inspecting favorable results
measurement_perturbation_control.admission_condition: If observed or unresolved measurement perturbation is comparable to the actionable effect, keep the diagnosis on hold rather than declare the collector negligible

derived_values: CPU delta / original wall with interval caveat
prohibited_interpretations: CPU time increase equals added instructions
major/minor faults equal CPU cache misses
no counter anomaly proves no interference
cgroup counters belong exclusively to the harness
post-run NUMA mapping proves C0 placement
ASLR address change proves layout slowdown
recording_and_analysis.aggregation: Keep equal-work total wall time and process results, not only chunk medians. Do not treat graph calls as independent requests.
recording_and_analysis.outlier_policy: Keep every planned observation and failure; no removal based on timing or counters

tier2_deferred.reason_to_open: A scheduled-CPU-side difference remains and distinguishing work versus stalls/frequency would change the next decision
tier2_deferred.coverage: Explicitly cover all existing worker TIDs and validate lifetimes. Main-thread inherit=1 opened after workers exist is insufficient.
tier2_deferred.multiplex_policy: Preserve raw coverage and counts; do not report an estimated scaled count as complete observation
tier2_deferred.permission_failure: Record unavailable and stop this optional branch; do not change permissions, sysctl or cgroup policy
cannot_establish_alone: library causal effect independent of process state

stop_conditions: CPU diagnostic result would not change the next implementation/measurement decision
Observer effect cannot be separated from the effect of interest
Required identity, scope, clock, counter, guard or correctness contracts fail
A finite predeclared trial does not reproduce the old delay: report non-reproduction and keep old evidence and hold status
executed_review_checks: Read fixed CONSULT_PRO_JA, RESULTS_JA, README, POLICY_AND_PLAN_JA
Read source timing, build, suite, launcher, gate and CPU C0 paths
Read saved eight process raw/STATUS/maps/guard and compute exact-work context
Verify balanced sampling formula with pure integer enumeration
Check API semantics in official Linux man-pages, Linux kernel and GNU libgomp documentation
